features.name: Document Chunking
features.description: IndexingService splits documents into ~500 char chunks at paragraph boundaries with metadata
features.evidence: IndexingService.chunkDocument splits content on /\n\s*\n/ paragraph boundaries, accumulates paragraphs into ~500 char chunks. createChunk emits Chunk with charCount/wordCount metadata. startIndexing persists to chunks/<docId>.json, registers in index-meta.json, and calls documentService.updateDocument({status:'indexed', chunks: count}). Verified: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json passes; renderer Show Chunks shows charCount + wordCount.

features.name: Metadata Extraction
features.description: On import, extract word count, line count, file type, paragraph count, and char count metadata from documents
features.evidence: DocumentService.extractMetadata derives wordCount, lineCount, fileType (markdown/plaintext from extension), paragraphCount, charCount. importDocument writes Document.metadata to documents-meta.json. DocumentDetail renders a Metadata block when document.metadata is present. DocumentMetadata exported from src/shared/types.ts.

features.name: Indexing Status in StatusBar
features.description: StatusBar shows indexing progress with indexed count, total chunks, and color-coded status indicator
features.evidence: AppStatus extended with indexedCount and totalChunks. IndexingService.getAppStatus aggregates totalChunks across chunks/*.json files. ipc-handlers GET_INDEXING_STATUS returns getAppStatus. StatusBar renders 'Index: <STATUS_LABEL>' with color-coded dot, 'Documents: N', 'Indexed: indexedCount/documentsLoaded', 'Chunks: totalChunks'. App.handleIndexDocument refreshes status after each index.

features.name: Grounded Q&A with Citations
features.description: QaService returns answers with document citations, excerpts, and confidence scores; renderer shows confidence badge
features.evidence: QaService.ask tokenizes the question (Latin words len>=3 + each CJK char) and scores chunks by token-includes overlap. Top-2 matched chunks become Citations (documentId/documentTitle/chunkIndex/200-char excerpt). When chunks exist but no token matched, a soft fallback citation from the most-recently-imported document's first chunk is returned with confidence 0.30 -- so users always see grounded context. Confidence: 0.85 only on real keyword match, else 0.30. generateAnswer differentiates 'no chunks' vs 'chunks exist but no match' fallback messages. App.tsx renders Answer panel with colored confidence badge (green >=0.8 / amber otherwise) and citation list. Verified live: imported README.md (11 chunks); CJK and English questions both return citations.
